title: Strong driving performance
summary: Reviews in this topic mainly describe the F70 as having strong or enjoyable performance, while a few comments specifically criticize braking performance and many excerpts are too vague to classify.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the car's performance as excellent, great, or good, with some describing a notably stronger driving feel.

negative.summary: Negative reviews focus on braking performance, citing poor brake quality or moments when braking is not good.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined excerpts mention performance without enough context to tell whether the view is favorable or unfavorable, and one example is ambiguous rather than explicit.

limitations: Many sampled fragments are very short mentions of 'performance' without enough detail to identify the specific aspect being discussed.
The negative evidence is limited to braking performance, so the sample does not show whether other performance-related complaints are present.
Examples are sentiment-stratified and not a random sample, so they should not be treated as representative of all reviews.
